title: 第18章 应急罐头第19章 说话的艺术
lines: “你好！”
苏午一声大喝，喝住了低着头往街对面走的女孩。
女孩半是惊讶半是紧张地转头来看，就见一道黑影从一辆轿车旁‘嗖’地一下冲出，虎扑向了自己。
此时霓虹黯灭，到处都黑漆漆的。
她只能看到那道黑影身材较高，体型匀称，根本看不到其面部表情。
女孩呆了呆。
趁着这会儿时间，苏午已经箭步冲到了跟前，一伸手抓向了女孩！
“拿来吧你！”
听到苏午语气里压抑不住的紧张与兴奋，女孩隔着一层黑暗，仿佛看到了对面男人脸上放肆而淫丨猥的笑容。
她心头一凉，猛然尖叫着后退：“你干嘛呀！”
那只抓向她胸口的手掌没有停留，跟着猝然向前，一把抓住了她——怀里那只羽色鲜艳的公鸡！
握住鸡脖子就将有七八斤重的大公鸡从女孩怀里薅了出来！
大公鸡拼命扑闪着翅膀，蹬着两条雄健有力的鸡大腿，羽毛飞散了一地！
“可算是逮住了！”
苏午长吁了一口气。
他隐隐猜测到，灯笼诡之所以不会杀死女孩，原因很可能就在她怀中抱着的这只大公鸡上。
然而即便猜测是这个原因，想要验证猜测也很困难。
先前他又试了几次，每次不是因为言辞过于激烈，引起女孩的警惕，不断与自己拉开距离，让自己没发在红灯笼升起前靠近她，
就是因为和她沟通消耗了太多时间，导致红灯笼直接升起，一样要了苏午的命。
想要撞见这个女孩，必须在夜间十点五十五分左右出现在当前的十字路口。
而在这个时间里，灯笼诡必然会有一次升起！
抓不住机会，就前功尽弃！
好在这一次苏午抓住了机会。
抓着鸡脖子，就好像抓住了自己命运的方向盘！
大公鸡叫得有点上气不接下气。
苏午提着它，就朝对面的女孩看去。
黑暗里，女孩姣好的面容上满是泪痕，瑟缩地站在距离苏午七八步远的位置，又不敢靠近，又不愿退却。
她小声地喊着大公鸡的名字：“应急罐头，应急罐头……”
不敢来争夺，也不想就这样放弃。
看得出来，她确实将这只大公鸡当宠物来用心养了。
只是既然那么用心来养，怎么取了‘应急罐头’这么个名字？
content_en:
"Hello!"
Su Wu shouted loudly, stopping the girl who was walking across the street with her head lowered.
The girl turned her head half surprised and half nervous, and saw a black shadow rushing out from beside a car, and the tiger pounced on her.
At this time, the neon lights dimmed and everything was dark.
She could only see that the dark figure was tall and well-proportioned, but could not see its facial expression at all.
The girl was stunned.
Taking advantage of this moment, Su Wu rushed forward and reached out to grab the girl!
"Bring it to you!"
Hearing the uncontrollable tension and excitement in Su Wu's tone, the girl seemed to see the wanton and obscene smile on the face of the man opposite her through a layer of darkness.
Her heart went cold, and she suddenly screamed and backed away: "What are you doing!"
The hand that grabbed her chest didn't stop, and then suddenly moved forward and grabbed her - the brightly colored rooster in her arms!
Holding the chicken's neck, the big cock weighing seven or eight pounds was pulled out from the girl's arms!
The big rooster flapped its wings desperately, kicked its two strong chicken thighs, and its feathers flew all over the floor!
"It's considered a catch!"
Su Wu let out a long breath.
He vaguely guessed that the reason why the lantern trick did not kill the girl was probably because of the big cock in her arms.
However, even if this is the reason, it is difficult to verify the guess.
He tried several times before, but each time it wasn't because his words were too intense, which aroused the girl's vigilance, and kept distancing herself from him, so that he didn't get close to her before the red lantern rose.
It was because too much time was spent communicating with her that the red lantern rose directly, which also killed Su Wu.
If you want to bump into this girl, you must appear at the current intersection at around 10:55 at night.
And during this time, the lantern will definitely rise once!
If you fail to seize the opportunity, all your efforts will be wasted!
Fortunately, Su Wu seized the opportunity this time.
Grabbing the chicken's neck is like grabbing the steering wheel of your own destiny!
"O-oh!"
The big rooster crowed a little out of breath.
Su Wu held it and looked at the girl opposite.
In the darkness, the girl's beautiful face was covered with tears, and she stood shivering seven or eight steps away from Su Wu, not daring to get closer or retreating.
She whispered the big cock's name: "Emergency can, emergency can..."
I don't dare to fight for it, and I don't want to give up just like that.
It can be seen that she really takes care of this big rooster as a pet.
But if you raise it with so much care, why did you choose the name "Emergency Can"?
